_comment: All paths relative to the bod_store install dir. Override with env BOD_CONFIG, BOD_DB_PATH, BOD_SNAPSHOT_PATH, BOD_EXAMPLES_PATH, BOD_STALE_S.
nova_snapshot_note: OPEN-18(a): NOVA reads ONLY this file (mode=ro&immutable=1). Written by the writer (SimStore commits / write_snapshot). Missing/unreadable/corrupt => snapshot_* status, state_stale HOLD, no motion. Env BOD_SNAPSHOT_PATH.
events_retention_note: PLACEHOLDER retention policy (spec §6.2 S3); purge_events() is a no-op until set
calibration_limits_note: Built at load time from calibration/register.json (mrl_default, verified=false) with calibration/measured.json overrides (pure read; OPEN-17). Operator apply_overrides writes calibration/overrides.log. Unapplied measured overrides are flagged in the status block. head.rollNeck/torso.midStom absent (OPEN-W9); torso.lowStom excluded (OPEN-W10). A joint or calibration_id with no entry => goal refused.
